sn22.61:1.2: “Bhikkhus, form is burning, feeling is burning, perception is burning, volitional formations are burning, consciousness is burning.
sn22.61:1.3: Seeing thus, bhikkhus, the instructed noble disciple experiences revulsion towards form, revulsion towards feeling, revulsion towards perception, revulsion towards volitional formations, revulsion towards consciousness.
sn22.61:1.4: Experiencing revulsion, he becomes dispassionate. Through dispassion his mind is liberated. When it is liberated there comes the knowledge: ‘It’s liberated.’
sn22.61:1.5: He understands: ‘Destroyed is birth, the holy life has been lived, what had to be done has been done, there is no more for this state of being.’”
